newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads Pakistani for drugs smuggling.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads Pakistani for drugs smuggling.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Friday beheaded a Pakistani man for smuggling heroin into the kingdom, raising the number of people executed so far this year to 79.
An Interior Ministry statement carried by the official Saudi Press Agency said a court had found the man guilty of smuggling an unspecified quantity of heroin into the kingdom.
The public execution took place in the capital Riyadh.
Saudi Arabia applies Islamic sharia law by beheading by the sword convicted murderers, rapists, drug traffickers and other criminals. Sixty-eight people were beheaded in 1996.
